summary: Iteration 43 - Fanvue-style UI Redesign Verification. All frontend pages tested successfully. CSS compilation error (border-white/8) was fixed by main agent. Verified: Landing page with Outfit font headings, magenta accent, pill-shaped buttons, creator mosaic. Creators page with search bar, filter pills (Trending/New) with magenta accent. Live page with red LIVE badges, gender tabs, sort options. Login/Register pages with surface-card, input-base inputs, btn-primary buttons, Google OAuth. Wallet page with balance hero, 4 coin packs grid, transactions table. Feed page with stories bar, paywall content blurred with unlock buttons. Mobile bottom nav with 5 tabs. AgeGate modal with proper styling and dismiss functionality.

issues: Some creator cards show broken/missing avatar images (displaying alt text like 'LysePrss', 'Test Host' instead of actual images) - this is likely a data/seeding issue, not a CSS issue
